title: inula candida subsp. limonella
intro: Inula candida subsp. limonella, commonly known as a subspecies of the elecampane plant, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. Inula candida subsp. limonella contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes and inulin, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to be due to its ability to relax the muscles in the respiratory tract, thin mucus, and reduce inflammation.
